description: This file defines a custom NSView subclass 'HoverChromeContainerView' used in macOS applications to display a container with hover effects, overlay chrome, draggable and resizable handle views, and a close button. It encapsulates UI components and user interaction logic for a specialized container view in a macOS application.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView
classes.description: A custom NSView that contains content and overlay chrome, with hover effects and tracking for mouse enter/exit events.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasDragHandleView
classes.description: A draggable view that allows window dragging.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasResizeHandleView
classes.description: A view that provides resize handle functionality for the container.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasChromeOverlayView
classes.description: An overlay view with a close button, drag and resize handles, and visual effects.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.PassthroughVisualEffectView
classes.description: A visual effect view that passes through mouse events.

methods.name: init(containing:)
methods.description: Initializes the container view with the provided content view, sets up layout constraints.

methods.name: updateTrackingAreas
methods.description: Updates the mouse tracking areas for hover detection.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Handles the close button action, invoking the onClose callback.
